test_searching_minimum: test the searching.minimum function that finds the index of the minimum element in a numpy array
test_searching_binary_search: test the searching.binary_search function that finds the index of a target value in a sorted numpy array
test_searching_quickselect: test the searching.quickselect function that finds the median element of a numpy array using quickselect algorithm
run_searching_tests: run the absltest unit tests for searching.minimum searching.binary_search and searching.quickselect algorithms
review_searching_test: review the SearchingTest class that validates searching algorithms against numpy baseline implementations
